description: Update the xrpld config generator: remove VL stanzas from .cfg output, update validators.txt with current mainnet VL sources (vl.ripple.com + unl.xrplf.org), update default ports to a standard 6-port layout with dual-protocol support, add self-signed SSL certificate generation with configurable validity, and restrict validator role to safe ports only.

userStories.title: Remove VL stanzas from cfg output
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the config renderer to stop emitting [validator_list_sites] and [validator_list_keys] sections in the .cfg file so that VL configuration lives only in validators.txt.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove VL section rendering from packages/generator/src/renderers/cfg-renderer.ts
Remove VL defaults from network presets in packages/generator/src/defaults/xrpld.ts (the cfg-level VL config, not the validators.txt data)
Generated .cfg output contains no [validator_list_sites] or [validator_list_keys] sections
VL-related validation rules for cfg output removed from packages/generator/src/validation.ts
Typecheck passes: cd packages/generator && npx tsc --noEmit
userStories.notes: Only remove VL from the .cfg rendering path. The validators-txt.ts generator must remain functional — it is updated in US-002.

userStories.title: Update validators.txt with current VL sources
userStories.description: As an operator, I want validators.txt to include both vl.ripple.com and unl.xrplf.org so that my node uses the latest validator list sources.
acceptanceCriteria: Mainnet validators.txt [validator_list_sites] section contains: https://vl.ripple.com and https://unl.xrplf.org
Mainnet validators.txt [validator_list_keys] section contains key ED2677ABFFD1B33AC6FBC3062B71F1E8397C1505E1C42C64D11AD1B28FF73F4734 preceded by comment #vl.ripple.com
Mainnet validators.txt [validator_list_keys] section contains key ED42AEC58B701EEBB77356FFFEC26F83C1F0407263530F068C7C73D392C7E06FD1 preceded by comment #unl.xrplf.org
Comments before each key use # prefix with the domain name (e.g., #vl.ripple.com)
Testnet and devnet VL sources remain as-is
validators.txt generation continues to work via the existing public API
Typecheck passes: cd packages/generator && npx tsc --noEmit
userStories.notes: The validators-txt.ts generator needs a new format that includes comments before keys. The current format may not support comment lines — update the renderer to handle this. Update the VL defaults data structure to associate each key with a source domain for comment generation.

userStories.title: Update default port configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the default ports to include all 6 standard ports so that generated configs expose the correct network interfaces out of the box.
acceptanceCriteria: Default port_peer: port=51235, ip=0.0.0.0, protocol=peer
Default port_rpc: port=5005, ip=0.0.0.0, protocol=http,https
Default port_rpc_admin_local: port=5006, ip=127.0.0.1, admin=127.0.0.1, protocol=http
Default port_wss: port=6005, ip=0.0.0.0, protocol=ws,wss
Default port_ws_admin_local: port=6006, ip=127.0.0.1, admin=127.0.0.1, protocol=ws
Default port_grpc: port=50051, ip=0.0.0.0, protocol=grpc, secure_gateway=127.0.0.1
[server] section lists all 6 port names in order: port_peer, port_rpc, port_rpc_admin_local, port_wss, port_ws_admin_local, port_grpc
Role-specific overrides in packages/generator/src/defaults/roles.ts are updated to be compatible with the new 6-port defaults
Typecheck passes: cd packages/generator && npx tsc --noEmit
userStories.notes: The deepMerge logic in xrpld.ts replaces arrays entirely, so port arrays in role overrides must include the full set or rely on common defaults. Dual-protocol ports (http,https and ws,wss) may require changes to protocol validation logic that currently restricts mixing.

userStories.title: Restrict validator role to safe ports with warning
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the validator role to only expose safe ports and include a warning comment so operators understand the security implications.
acceptanceCriteria: Validator role restricts to safe ports only: port_peer, port_rpc_admin_local, port_ws_admin_local (no public-facing port_rpc, port_wss, port_grpc)

Generated config includes a comment warning above the [server] section for validator role: '# WARNING: Exposing RPC/WS ports publicly on a validator can compromise network security. Only admin-local ports are enabled by default.'
Validator role port override in packages/generator/src/defaults/roles.ts updated with the 3-port restriction
cfg-renderer supports emitting comments above sections when provided
Typecheck passes: cd packages/generator && npx tsc --noEmit
userStories.notes: The validator role currently restricts to peer + admin RPC/WS on localhost only. This story ensures it stays restricted with the new 6-port default set and adds an explicit warning comment in the generated config.

userStories.title: Add SSL cert input fields and parsing
userStories.description: As an operator, I want to specify cert email and validity days so the generator knows how to create my SSL certificates.
acceptanceCriteria: Add ssl_cert_email (string) field to config input type in packages/generator/src/types/xrpld-input.ts
Add ssl_cert_validity_days (number, default 365) field to config input type
JSON parser supports ssl_cert_email and ssl_cert_validity_days fields
Env parser supports SSL_CERT_EMAIL and SSL_CERT_VALIDITY_DAYS environment variables
Validation: ssl_cert_email must be a valid email format when provided
Validation: ssl_cert_validity_days must be a positive integer when provided
Typecheck passes: cd packages/generator && npx tsc --noEmit
userStories.notes: These fields are consumed by the cert generator in US-006. This story only adds the schema, parsing, and validation — not the actual cert generation.

userStories.title: Generate self-signed SSL certificates
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the generator to create self-signed SSL certificates and place them in a certs/ directory relative to the config file so that dual-protocol ports work immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: Generator creates a certs/ directory relative to the output cfg file path
Generator produces certs/server.key (RSA 2048-bit private key) and certs/server.crt (self-signed X.509 certificate)
Certificate uses OpenSSL-standard fields: CN (defaults to hostname or 'xrpld'), O (optional), emailAddress (from ssl_cert_email if provided)
Certificate validity defaults to 365 days, configurable via ssl_cert_validity_days
Dual-protocol ports (port_rpc, port_wss) include ssl_key=./certs/server.key and ssl_cert=./certs/server.crt in generated .cfg
Cert generation is skipped if the user provides their own ssl_key/ssl_cert paths
Private key file is created with restrictive permissions (0600)
Use Node.js built-in crypto module (crypto.generateKeyPairSync RSA 2048 + crypto.createSign for self-signing) or shell out to openssl if built-in API is insufficient
Typecheck passes: cd packages/generator && npx tsc --noEmit
userStories.notes: Prefer Node.js built-in crypto to avoid new dependencies. If X.509 self-signing is not feasible with built-in crypto alone, shelling out to openssl is acceptable. Cert paths in the config should use relative paths (./certs/) so configs are portable.

userStories.title: Update user-override config schema for new ports
userStories.description: As an operator, I want to override individual ports via a config object/JSON so I can customize the default port layout.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can override any of the 6 default ports via JSON input (port number, IP, protocol)
Partial overrides work (e.g., changing only port_rpc.port to 8080 keeps all other defaults)
Example configs in packages/generator/examples/ are updated to reflect the new 6-port layout
Typecheck passes: cd packages/generator && npx tsc --noEmit
userStories.notes: The existing port override mechanism should work — this story ensures it is tested and examples are updated for the new 6-port default set.

userStories.title: Update all tests
userStories.description: As a developer, I want all existing tests updated so the test suite passes with the new port defaults, updated validators.txt, and cert generation.
acceptanceCriteria: Integration test expected outputs (packages/generator/tests/integration/expected/) updated to reflect 6 ports and no VL stanzas in .cfg
Integration test expected validators.txt output updated with new mainnet VL sources and comment format
Unit tests for port defaults verify all 6 ports with correct values
Tests for cert generation added (cert files created, correct paths in config)
Tests for ssl_cert_email and ssl_cert_validity_days parsing and validation added
Tests for validator role port restriction and warning comment added
All tests pass: cd packages/generator && npx vitest run
Coverage remains at or above 80%: cd packages/generator && npx vitest run --coverage
userStories.notes: This is the final story. All prior stories should be implemented before updating tests comprehensively. Individual stories may fix broken tests as they go, but this story ensures full coverage and all integration test fixtures are updated.
